title: Revenue recognition
description: For a change to contracts, plans or billing: apply the five steps of IFRS 15 and have finance approve the revenue treatment before release.

sources.title: IFRS Foundation, IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

rules.instruction: For each new or changed contract or plan, list in the revenue memo the performance obligations it contains and the standalone selling price of each.
rules.verification: Open the revenue memo and check that every product line of the contract template appears as an obligation or is explained as part of another.

rules.instruction: Record discounts, free periods, credits, refunds and usage-based fees in the transaction price of the revenue memo instead of leaving them out.
rules.verification: Compare the price terms of the contract template with the memo and check that each one is reflected in the transaction price.

rules.instruction: Configure the revenue schedule so that revenue follows the satisfaction of each obligation, over the service period for a subscription, not the invoice or payment date.
rules.verification: Export the revenue schedule of a test contract and check that monthly revenue equals the allocated price spread over the service period.

rules.instruction: Ask the finance owner to approve the revenue treatment of new or changed contract templates before they are used with customers.
rules.verification: Check that the task record names the finance approver and the approval date, earlier than the first contract signed on the template.
